# apple_app_info_localization (Resource)

Sets an app's localized App Store name, subtitle and privacy information for one locale. Changes apply to the app info of the version being prepared and need a version in an editable state. The app's primary locale always has a localization: creating this resource for it manages the existing one. Add the same locale to each version with the version localization resource. Import it with `<app_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_info_localization" "en_us" {
  app_id             = data.apple_app.example.id
  locale             = "en-US"
  name               = "Example"
  subtitle           = "Examples, fast"
  privacy_policy_url = "https://example.com/privacy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Name of the app on the App Store, up to 30 characters.

### Optional

- `privacy_choices_url` (String) URL where users can manage their privacy choices.
- `privacy_policy_text` (String) Privacy policy text, for tvOS apps.
- `privacy_policy_url` (String) URL of the app's privacy policy.
- `subtitle` (String) Subtitle, up to 30 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_info_localization.en_us
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    locale = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_info_localization.en_us 1234567890/en-US
```
